param: Λ Recruitment rate of newborns into children susceptible class (paper Table 1: L)
μ Natural death rate (lifespan ~72 years; per week)
ξ_U Un-monitored children vaccination rate (paper Table 1: xU)
ξ_M Monitored children vaccination rate (paper Table 1: xM)
ξ_A Adult vaccination rate / catch-up vaccination rate (paper Table 1: xA; taken 0 during Nepal fitting period)
ψ Maturation rate from child group to adult group (paper Table 1: j; computed as 1/(15*52)=0.0013 per week)
β_C Transmission rate for children (paper Table 1: bC)
β_A Transmission rate for adults (paper Table 1: bA; assumed lower than children)
ε Residual susceptibility factor for un-monitored vaccinated (paper uses infection rate εβ; (1-ε) is vaccine effectiveness)
η_U Rate of becoming immune for un-monitored vaccinated children (paper Table 1: hU)
η_M Rate of becoming immune for monitored vaccinated children (paper Table 1: hM)
η_A Rate of becoming immune for vaccinated adults (paper Table 1: hA; taken 0 during Nepal fitting period)
δ Progression rate from exposed to infectious (incubation ~10 days => δ≈0.7 per week; paper Table 1: d)
γ Recovery rate from infection (recovery ~15 days => γ=1/2 per week; paper Table 1: g)
d Disease-induced death rate (paper Table 1: d; distinct from δ in equations)
